description: Create a PayPal Checkout order in USD and return the hosted PayPal approve URL. productId accepts id OR slug. Optional shipToCountry for soft shipping estimate (finalized on PayPal). NO cart. Display: MCP App Pay here → host card → messageToHuman. Wait ~60s then poll getOrderStatus every 60s. Prefer quickCheckout when the human only named a device.

productId.description: Product id or slug (required unless slug is set)

shipToCountry.description: ISO country for soft shipping estimate

name: createCheckout
